title: Chess
description: Chess for two people and one phone, drawn flat so you can actually tell the pieces apart. Lay it between you — White at the near edge, Black at the far one — and the board never turns, exactly as at a real board. Full rules: castling, en passant, underpromotion, stalemate, dead position, the fifty-move clock and repetition, all verified against the published perft counts. Three boards: tournament green, walnut and slate.
